result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh, his God, when he became powerful?

readings.answer: By entering the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
readings.support: he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says Uzziah was unfaithful because he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense, matching the key in meaning and wording.

result.reason: Verse 26:16 directly states that his trespass was entering the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
